auth.description:
To connect your Moxie workspace:

  1. Log in to Moxie and click **Workspace Settings** (bottom left).
  2. Open **Connected Apps** and go to the **Integrations** tab.
  3. Under **Custom Integration**, click **Enable Custom Integration**.
  4. Copy the **API Key** and the **Base URL** (it looks like `https://pod01.withmoxie.com/api/public`) and click **Save**.
auth.props.apiKey.description: The API Key of the Moxie CRM account
auth.props.baseUrl.description: The Base URL shown next to the API key, for example https://pod01.withmoxie.com/api/public

triggers.moxie_trigger_client_created.de: Triggered when a new client is created.
triggers.moxie_trigger_client_created.pr:
- In Moxie, go to **Workspace Settings > Connected Apps > Integrations**.
        - Under **Custom Integration**, click **Add Rest Hook**.
        - In the endpoint field, paste the following URL:
            ```text
            {{webhookUrl}}
            ```

        - Select the event **`Client Created`** and click **Save**.

        Deliveries for any other event type are ignored, and a delivery repeated within 15 minutes runs the flow only once.

triggers.moxie_trigger_client_updated.pr:
- In Moxie, go to **Workspace Settings > Connected Apps > Integrations**.
        - Under **Custom Integration**, click **Add Rest Hook**.
        - In the endpoint field, paste the following URL:
            ```text
            {{webhookUrl}}
            ```

        - Select the event **`Client Updated`** and click **Save**.

        Deliveries for any other event type are ignored, and a delivery repeated within 15 minutes runs the flow only once.
